title: Mock: Online Auction (eBay-lite)
summary: Timed auctions with bid-increment rules, anti-sniping extensions, outbid notifications (Observer), an idempotent close, and consistent bidding under contention.
hints: Validate the bid in this order: auction open → bidder isn't the seller → bidder isn't already leading → amount meets the minimum.
Minimum = startingPrice if there are no bids yet, else highest + minIncrement.
Anti-sniping: after accepting a bid, if `end − now < 60 000`, set `end = now + 60 000`.

The ordering requirement is the twist. Notifying while holding the per-auction lock keeps events ordered, but a slow listener then blocks bidding. The production answer is a per-auction event queue drained by one dispatcher. `close` stores its Result so a second call returns the same object and notifies nobody.
